title: L4-L5 absolute nucleus IDP vs pure moment, w/o interspinous ligament (Heuer 2007b)
condition: cumulative resection step 2 of 7: w/o interspinous ligament

quantity.name: IDP absolute
quantity.definition: absolute nucleus-centre pressure at peak moment, median over specimens

source.authors: Heuer F, Schmidt H, Claes L, Wilke HJ
source.sample: same specimens as Heuer 2007a; no radiographic disc degeneration (grade <2, Mimura); 8 human cadaveric L4-L5 FSUs (4 M, 4 F) evaluated; 1 M + 1 F excluded for early failure; n=3 at 10 Nm for w/oFC..w/oALL

protocol.summary: Same protocol as Heuer 2007a: 15 min 500 N axial preconditioning, then pure unconstrained moments 1/2.5/5/7.5/10 Nm at 1.0 deg/s, 2.5 cycles (last evaluated), no preload; L5 fixed, L4 on gimbal. IDP: piezo-resistive probe (MIPM FMSPEZ50, 1.45 mm dia, 4.4 mm long) inserted into the centre of the nucleus from right lateral via 14G needle, position checked radiographically; absolute pressure (unloaded baseline included, averaged unloaded IDP 0.04 MPa).
how_to_simulate: Fix the caudal half of L5; L4 free (gimbal), no preload
Apply pure moments 1, 2.5, 5, 7.5, 10 Nm in flexion and in extension
Read hydrostatic nucleus pressure (absolute, MPa) at the nucleus centre at each peak moment (loading branch)
For defect stages remove structures cumulatively in the Heuer order (SSL, ISL, FL, FC, vertebral arches, PLL, ALL)
protocol.notes: IDP absolute (not normalised). Only flexion and extension are shown (Figs 7-8); lateral bending/axial rotation IDP only as IDP-ROM regressions (Fig 9). Stage order: INTACT -> w/oSSL -> w/oISL -> w/oFL -> w/oFC -> w/oVA -> w/oPLL -> w/oALL (w/oNUC not measurable). Values absolute, not % intact.

extraction.from: Fig 7 (flexion), Fig 8 (extension); neutral value from Results text
extraction.uncertainty: ±0.01 MPa (axis 0-0.6 MPa; bar-top method validated on Heuer 2007a Table 1 within 0.3% of axis range)
extraction.check_notes: Re-digitised flexion 7.5 Nm INTACT (0.267 vs 0.269) and w/oPLL (0.388 vs 0.388) from a separate 2x zoom; within uncertainty. 10 Nm n=3 for w/oFC..w/oALL from 'n=3' bracket and Results text. verified 2026-11-12 independent check: OK (re-digitised w/oISL bars Fig 7 p.799 and Fig 8 p.800, all 10 within ±0.01 MPa; 10 Nm n=3 bracket excludes w/oISL so n=8 correct)

pass_rule.rule: |model-median| <= max(0.03 MPa, 20%); sign of change vs previous stage

shared_sample_with: wilke2025: Heuer 2007a/b pooled in Wilke 2025 L4-L5 ROM/NZ
